data: Penalty shootouts, tournament exits, and heartbreaks — how well do you know England's most painful football moments?
In which year did England lose a penalty shootout to West Germany in the 1990 World Cup semi-final?
England lost 4–3 on penalties to West Germany in the 1990 World Cup semi-final in Turin, Italia 90.
Which England player missed the decisive penalty against Argentina in the 1998 World Cup?
David Batty's miss meant England were eliminated by Argentina in the last 16 of the 1998 World Cup.
Gareth Southgate famously missed a penalty in which tournament?
Southgate missed England's crucial penalty in the Euro 1996 semi-final shootout against Germany at Wembley.
England were famously knocked out of the 2010 World Cup in the last 16 by which country?
Germany beat England 4–1 in the Round of 16 at the 2010 World Cup, controversially disallowing a Lampard goal.
What was the score when England lost to Iceland at Euro 2016?
England lost 1–2 to Iceland in the Round of 16 at Euro 2016, one of their most embarrassing exits.
England lost the Euro 2020 final on penalties to which country?
Italy beat England 3–2 on penalties in the Euro 2020 final at Wembley after a 1–1 draw.
Which England player received a red card against Argentina at the 1998 World Cup, reducing England to 10 men?
David Beckham was sent off for a petulant kick at Diego Simeone, leaving England to play most of the match with 10 men.
England have never won a major international tournament other than which one?
The 1966 FIFA World Cup on home soil remains England's only major international honour.
Which goalkeeper saved the decisive penalty for Portugal against England in the Euro 2004 quarter-final?
Ricardo saved Darius Vassell's penalty and then scored the winning penalty himself to send England out of Euro 2004.
England were eliminated in the group stage of which World Cup after losing to the USA?
England lost 1–0 to the USA at the 1950 World Cup in Brazil, considered one of the greatest upsets in football history.
Which England player missed the crucial penalty in the Euro 2020 final shootout first?
Bukayo Saka had his penalty saved by Donnarumma, handing Italy the Euro 2020 title. Sancho and Rashford also missed.
In which year did England fail to qualify for a World Cup, finishing behind Poland on goal difference?
England failed to qualify for the 1974 World Cup after a 1–1 draw with Poland meant they missed out on goal difference.
